continuity_scope: Demon's Souls 2020 PlayStation 5 remake, English (US) PlayStation product-page witness. This pass treats it as a remake of the PlayStation classic, released in November 2020, and does not merge unreviewed original-2009 text, regional translations, patches, cut material, guides, or other FromSoftware/Souls continuities into the remake claims.
work_or_witnesses: PlayStation: Demon's Souls exclusive PS5 game page, Game Overview, Key Features, Editions, FAQs, and product metadata
coverage_rule: All stable named non-avatar individuals directly named and functionally described in the selected official remake witness: King Allant, the Old One, and the Maiden in Black. The player-created Slayer of Demons is explicitly excluded as a role/avatar. No additional NPC, boss, knight, demon, or other named individual is added without a claim-level official profile or reproducible direct in-game dialogue/item-description locator.
omissions: The player-created lone warrior/Slayer of Demons, all player build, class, weapon, soul, world tendency, character tendency, choices, invasions, summons, deaths, and endings.

All named NPCs, bosses, demons, knights, merchants, invaders, summons, and other dramatic individuals outside King Allant, the Old One, and the Maiden in Black because no selected official claim-level profile or direct in-game dialogue/item-description locator supports their records.
Classes, worlds, tendencies, species, bosses as categories, items, armor, weapons, souls, places, online systems, and mechanics as character nodes.

The 2009 original as a separate detailed continuity; regional and non-English localization; remake patches; Digital Deluxe item content as story proof; adaptations; other Souls titles; fan/community/wiki material, dialogue/item-description transcriptions, walkthroughs, lore videos, data-mines, and secondary databases.
uncertainties: The official PlayStation page is a high-level remake/product witness. Direct in-game dialogue and item descriptions were not available in the reviewed first-party evidence, so no detailed lore, motive, chronology, or unlisted relationship claim is made.

Claims about King Allant, the Old One, and the Maiden in Black are presented as the official remake overview/FAQ framing. They are not expanded with interpretations often derived from ambiguous dialogue or item descriptions.

The page identifies the product as a remake and gives original/2020 release context, but it does not provide a claim-by-claim change log. Original and remake textual/visual/mechanical differences remain unadjudicated.
English, French (France), Brazilian Portuguese, and Mexican Spanish voice/screen languages are listed for the US product; only English wording was reviewed. No translation-equivalence claim is made.
The online invasion/cooperative options and the player quest make alliances, deaths, success, and endings variable. No multiplayer encounter or avatar outcome is universalized.
evidence_basis: First-party PlayStation/PlayStation Studios product-page material only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community source, guide, review, walkthrough, data mine, or secondary lore source is used as canonical evidence.
